name: Sui Dollar
oneLiner: USDsui is Sui's native dollar issued by Bridge (FinCEN-registered MSB) and redeemable 1:1, backed by short-dated U.S. Treasuries, repos, MMFs, and cash.
collateral: Bridge Open Issuance USD reserves backed at least 1:1 by equivalent fiat value, including short-dated U.S. Treasuries, overnight Treasury repos, government money-market funds, and cash in segregated bankruptcy-remote accounts
pegMechanism: Bridge Open Issuance mint and burn rail: Bridge mints USDsui when fiat or supported crypto/stablecoin deposits are allocated to reserves, and burns USDsui on redemption before releasing equivalent fiat value or supported stablecoin output

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDsui is a Bridge-issued U.S. dollar payment stablecoin for Sui with 1:1 redemption through Bridge Open Issuance.

genius.licensingRegulator: OCC (conditional national trust bank charter, Feb 2026); FinCEN / state money transmitter regulators
genius.notes: Bridge received conditional OCC approval (Feb 12, 2026) to organize Bridge National Trust Bank, NA — an uninsured national trust bank, which maps to the 'federal-qualified-nonbank' PPSI pathway under the OCC's GENIUS Act NPRM. Bridge publicly states its compliance framework 'already positions Bridge to be GENIUS ready.' This is a trust-charter conditional approval under existing OCC authority, not a PPSI approval under the GENIUS Act (which remains in proposed-rules phase). No PPSI approvals exist as of 2026-06-18.

references.label: OCC Corporate Decision #1365 — Bridge Ventures LLC conditional national trust bank charter

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: No PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or official GENIUS Act PPSI application has been publicly filed or approved for Bridge or USDsui. Bridge's OCC conditional charter approval is a trust-charter action under existing OCC authority, not a GENIUS Act PPSI authorization.

blacklistabilityReview.evidence: Explicit Yes retained: centralized governance metadata indicates issuer or admin control; registry links were reviewed for direct freeze, blacklist, pause, burn, or upgrade authority.

reserves.name: Bridge USD reserves (short-dated Treasuries, Treasury repos, government MMFs, and cash)

mintAuthority.summary: USDsui is issued through Bridge's Open Issuance platform on Sui. The TreasuryCap was wrapped at deploy into Bridge's shared TokenAuthority contract (0xd4fc1ca0b...) via stablecoin_manager::register_stablecoin. Minting requires MinterRole, held by Bridge operational address 0xb1e7dc9a5... The TokenAuthority is shared (no single owner) with Bridge controlling AdminRole and MinterRole.

controls.label: Bridge TokenAuthority shared contract (TreasuryCap wrapper)
controls.evidence: Sui RPC: tx CRwtcn7FYUu7Sr7EzVToa1nbDRzVfmB1djFqJWyVJEjv called stablecoin_manager::register_stablecoin shortly after deploy, wrapping TreasuryCap 0x57eafc43... into a Stablecoin<RESERVE_LEDGER, USDSUI> struct (object 0x80954159...) stored in the TokenAuthority's tokens ObjectBag. TreasuryCap is non-transferable while wrapped; total_supply.value = 73,574,877,360,000 (73.57M USDsui at 6 decimals). TokenAuthority owner = Shared (initial_shared_version 741908290). Package 0x94e8cb8df... contains modules: reserve_ledger, token_authority, stablecoin_manager, minter, burner, blocklist, bridge_ecosystem_minter. Init bytecode constant string: 'USDsui is Sui's native, USD-backed stablecoin, issued via Bridge's Open Issuance platform'.

controls.label: Bridge MinterRole holder (0xb1e7dc9a...)
controls.evidence: Sui RPC suix_queryTransactionBlocks: MinterRole<RESERVE_LEDGER> and MinterRole<USDSUI> (plus MinterRole<stablecoin::STABLECOIN> and BurnerRole) all held by 0xb1e7dc9a51c2e86e45f6c930f411b8f22dbc2204c964d174e3666816f7ecaac3. This address calls minter.mint and minter.wrap regularly in active Sui transactions — confirmed operational Bridge minter. AdminRole held by 0xb7fec6160... (holds UpgradeCaps for stablecoin and reserve_ledger packages). BlocklistRole held separately by 0x50b9aa5bd...

review.evidence: Sui RPC: TreasuryCap 0x57eafc43... traced to wrapping tx CRwtcn7F... which called Bridge's stablecoin_manager::register_stablecoin; TreasuryCap is locked in Stablecoin<RESERVE_LEDGER, USDSUI> wrapper (obj 0x80954159...) inside TokenAuthority shared object 0xd4fc1ca0b... MinterRole confirmed at 0xb1e7dc9a5... (active operational Bridge minter). AdminRole at 0xb7fec616... (holds UpgradeCaps for Bridge packages). Package 0x94e8cb8df... self-identifies as Bridge Open Issuance in bytecode. No external party can access TreasuryCap — it is wrapped in a non-transferable, shared contract object. Bridge confirmed as sole mint controller.
